high_level_description: The image depicts a formal event where a man is giving a speech at a podium. The setting appears to be an official or governmental venue, as indicated by the presence of multiple flags behind him. The flags include the American flag on the left, a blue flag with a seal in the center, and another flag on the right that resembles the flag of Mexico. The man is dressed in a dark suit and tie, standing behind a podium with a microphone. The podium has a yellow background with a silhouette of a city skyline, suggesting an urban context, possibly New York City given the style of the skyline.
